title: ‘It Was Insulting’: When Steinem Said Young Women Backed Sanders to Chase Men
summary: During the 2016 presidential campaign, Gloria Steinem was asked about the young women supporting Bernie Sanders over Hillary Clinton. Her answer created a brief hullabaloo.
